sql: with f as (select distinct lo.market_ticker, lo.event_ticker, lo.limit_price, lo.created_at from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Dmmsell10' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled') select f.market_ticker, split_part(f.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, f.limit_price as entry_px, to_char(f.created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') as entered, round((select p.realized_pnl from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1)::numeric,2) as realized from f where (select coalesce(p.realized_pnl,0) from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) < 0 order by realized asc
